scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c teal,yellow --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: concurrently -n api,web -c teal,yellow "npm run build:api" "npm run build:web"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov:api && npm run test:cov:web
